_note: Informe de fin de partida. recap_fragments: frases según banderas, en orden de prioridad (se muestran hasta 3, salteando las de recap_skip del final). lenses: textos de los tres modelos de Allison.
goal_line: October 1962 could have ended ten different ways. Find them all.

recap_fragments.text: One of your orders arrived too late.
Some squadrons never heard the recall.
You let the military retaliate without asking you.
You raised the alert to DEFCON 2.
You answered the U-2 shootdown with force.
You held back after the U-2 was shot down.
You held the line in Berlin.
You made a promise about Turkey that could never be public.
You traded the Jupiters in public.
You promised not to invade Cuba.
You opened a back channel to Moscow.
You widened the room, and the secret leaked.

rational.name: RATIONAL ACTOR
rational.line: You weighed the options and chose.
rational.dominant: Most of your crisis was calculation: goals, options, consequences. Allison's first model, and the one the cards make easiest to believe.

organizational.name: ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOR
organizational.line: The options came from plans already written.
organizational.dominant: Most of your crisis was decided by what the organizations could do and when. You chose among plans you did not write.

governmental.name: GOVERNMENTAL POLITICS
governmental.line: The choice came out of the argument in the room.
governmental.dominant: Most of your crisis was bargaining: who knew what, who leaked, whose voice carried. The decision came out of that argument.

timeout_line: %d of your decisions were made by the clock: the organization did what it was already going to do.
